payload.summary: All three amendments verified against the actual codebase. The floating-point clamping (fr-7-dd6f9b61) and registry consistency (fr-7-80ce85a0) amendments identify real, confirmed issues worth fixing. The blocking amendment (fr-7-c178d602) is factually incorrect — root-zone oxygenation is fully implemented in substrate.rs with rooted-only biomass filtering, saturating exponential bonus, and comprehensive integration tests including a 500-hour planted/unplanted divergence test.

votes.rationale: Verified: line 128 of substrate.rs computes `effective_penetration_cm = base_penetration_cm + root_oxygenation_bonus_cm` without clamping. The exponential saturation formula bounds the bonus to `remaining_depth_cm`, but IEEE 754 does not guarantee `base + (total - base) == total` — the sum can exceed `total_depth_cm` by a few ULPs. While downstream consumers do clamp, `.min(total_depth_cm)` is a zero-cost defensive measure that eliminates the entire class of issue at the source. Accept.

Verified: `substrate_oxygenation_breakdown()` at line 83 calls `compute_habitat_registry(state)` to build a fresh registry, while `step_substrate_zones()` at line 60 reads `state.habitat_registry` (the cached version). If the cached registry is stale (e.g., after plant/geometry changes but before engine tick), these two code paths will produce divergent breakdowns for the same TankState. This is a real consistency issue. Either documenting the precondition on the public function or unifying the registry source would eliminate a subtle correctness hazard for API consumers.

This amendment is factually incorrect. I verified the codebase directly: (1) substrate.rs lines 87-136 implement the full root-zone oxygenation calculation with a saturating exponential bonus formula; (2) lines 156-183 filter exclusively for `RootFeedingRosette` guild (rooted-only biomass); (3) the saturation formula `remaining_depth * (1 - exp(-(biomass * rate) / depth))` provides biomass-dependent saturation; (4) `crates/tank_core/tests/root_zone_oxygenation.rs` contains `planted_vs_unplanted_diverge_in_penetration_depth()` which runs two states for 500 hours and asserts planted has deeper O₂ penetration. All acceptance criteria cited by the amendment are met. The amendment confuses the alkalinity stoichiometry changes (which are additional work in the same changeset) with the entirety of the changeset.
